0022600152.text: The Spurs (3-2, eighth in the West) host the Timberwolves (4-2, sixth in the West) as San Antonio looks to extend a three-game winning streak, while Minnesota is riding a one-game win streak. San Antonio is 1-2 at home and 2-0 on the road, and Minnesota is 2-1 at home and 2-1 on the road. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and the Timberwolves are without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Spurs lost the 2025-26 regular-season series 1-2 and then won the 2025-26 playoff series 4-2, including a 139-109 win in Minneapolis on May 15.
